jobs.title: POS Implementation & Support Specialist
jobs.description:
**All Business Solutions** is seeking a bilingual (English/Spanish) POS Implementation \& Support Specialist with hands\-on experience supporting point\-of\-sale systems.

This is a customer\-facing technical and merchant\-operations role supporting primarily restaurants and hospitality and retail businesses with day\-to\-day POS issues, account maintenance, installations, onboarding, hardware, payment terminals, and merchant\-service requests.

This role is ideal for someone who combines technical ability with strong communication and customer service skills and is comfortable working directly with merchants in fast\-paced environments.

You will support a wide range of businesses, primarily restaurants—by installing, configuring, and supporting POS systems, ensuring a smooth onboarding and long\-term client experience, while also contributing to the ongoing rollout and evolution of **Salsa POS** as it moves toward full market deployment.

About the Role

● This is a hybrid role combining remote and onsite support.

● Specialist is responsible for:

● Installing and configuring POS systems

● Supporting onboarding and go\-live

● Troubleshooting issues in real time

● Training staff and operators

● You will work directly with business owners, managers, and staff, requiring clear communication, professionalism, and the ability to solve problems under pressure.

● This is not a traditional IT role. Respond to routine merchant questions and service requests with clear ownership from request through completion.

● It is a customer\-facing, operations\-focused position where communication and service are just as important as technical skills.

Responsibilities

● Learn and become proficient in the POS systems we support

● Install and configure POS hardware, including terminals, printers, and peripherals

● Support clients in basic merchant services, onboarding, training, and go\-live processes

● Provide both remote and on\-site support to merchants

● Troubleshoot POS software, hardware, and payment\-related issues

● Maintain accurate documentation and update tickets with clear notes and status

● Assist with staging and preparation of POS systems prior to deployment

● Communicate clearly with merchants to resolve issues efficiently

● Deliver a high level of customer service and maintain a positive client experience

Ideal Candidate

● Experience supporting POS systems (Required)

● Bilingual in English and Spanish (Required)

● Hospitality or restaurant experience (Preferred)

● Strong communication skills (critical for success in this role)

● Excellent customer service and ability to remain professional under pressure

● Ability to troubleshoot and problem\-solve efficiently

● Highly organized with strong attention to detail

● Self\-motivated with a strong work ethic

● Comfortable working both remotely and onsite

● Tech\-savvy and able to quickly learn new systems

Compensation: $19–$25 per hour (based on relevant experience and demonstrated capability**.**)

Benefits

● Health Insurance

● 401(k) with company match (after 3 months)

● Performance\-based bonuses

● Paid holidays

● Paid birthday off

● 5 PTO days \+ 5 vacation days

● $20 monthly gym credit

● Company\-provided laptop

● Ongoing training and development

● Continuing education support

● Industry conferences and events

● Internal promotion pathways

● Team outings, celebrations, and company events

Pay: $19\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Have you personally installed or configured POS hardware such as terminals, printers, cash drawers, tablets, handhelds, routers, or payment devices?
* Have you handled day\-to\-day merchant support requests such as bank account changes, account updates, statements, funding/deposit questions, payment\-processing questions, or processor documentation?
* Have you worked with payment processors, merchant\-service providers, or payment terminals before?
* Which POS systems have you personally supported, installed, configured, or troubleshot?
* Are you fluent in both English and Spanish?

Experience:

* supporting POS systems: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* English / Spanish (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Houston, TX 77070 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: EHR Certified Systems Analyst II (Healthy Planet)
jobs.description:
Located in the metropolitan area of Sacramento, the Adventist Health corporate headquarters have been based in Roseville, California, for more than 40 years. In 2019, we unveiled our WELL\-certified campus \- a rejuvenating place for associates systemwide to collaborate, innovate and connect.
  

  

Adventist Health Roseville and shared service teams have access to enjoy a welcoming space designed to promote well\-being and inspire your best work.


Job Summary:


Adventist Health Roseville is seeking an EHR Certified Systems Analyst II for a full\-time position working 8\-hour day shifts. This is a fully remote opportunity, offering the flexibility to work from home while supporting our team based in Roseville, California.


Performs various duties relating to information systems applications including the design, build, implementation, support, and testing of computer software and related processes. Works with project and support teams to ensure appropriate development, training, support, and evaluation of major computer applications.


Job Requirements:


Education and Work Experience:


* Associate's/Technical Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Required
* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education/related experience: Preferred
* Three healthcare IT application/technical experience or equivalent: Required
* Two years’ applicable Epic application experience: Preferred
Licenses/Certifications:


* Epic Certification/Accreditation in area of responsibility: Required
Essential Functions:


* Maintains moderately complex system software utilizing established standards and departmental protocols, to meet user requests/specifications. Evaluates user requests for special enhancements to system software. Works with customers to gather specifications for the purchase, development, and installation of system software. Maintains service level agreements with various end\-user departments and enterprise business units.
* Coordinates analysis of documentation and workflows in departments, and designs/redesigns system components to support appropriate workflows. Assists in analyzing existing methods and developing alternatives to increase operations and production efficiency. Performs a needs assessment for complex workflows, customers, and/or clinical/revenue areas. Analyzes and documents reporting needs of end users. Identifies potential process and/or department\-specific risks and assists in strategies to mitigate or resolve them.
* Develops and follows project work plans. Leads project meetings and works cooperatively with team members to coordinate assigned duties with the overall program and related projects. Researches, documents, and facilitates resolution to issues reported by end\-users. Tests system software per checklist guidelines and participates in the development of test scenarios. Collaborates with technical teams to define hardware/network requirements and to research and problem\-solve technical issues.
* Presents training to a variety of audiences. Ensures that system documentation is current and available to the customer and that customers are educated as to where to find it. Assesses how users are progressing with their use of system applications and assists with optimization training to further develop user proficiency, efficiency, and satisfaction. Leads optimization activities to ensure staff effectively use the systems.
* Handles ongoing on call duties for one or more applications which generate Incidents outside of business hours. Provides on call support as needed of the most critical applications. Troubleshoots and resolves system issues escalated by the help desk. As needed, up to 25%, travel on site to provide support during go\-live events and other work\-related occasions. Travel could occur during standard off\-hours support times.
* Performs other job\-related duties as assigned.
Organizational Requirements:


Adventist Health is committed to the safety and wellbeing of our associates and patients. Therefore, we require that all associates receive all required vaccinations as a condition of employment and annually thereafter, where applicable. Medical and religious exemptions may apply.
  

  

Adventist Health participates in E\-Verify. Visit https://adventisthealth.org/careers/everify/ for more information about E\-Verify. By choosing to apply, you acknowledge that you have accessed and read the E\-Verify Participation and Right to Work notices and understand the contents therein.
